entries.text: DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-03: health 7/7 green, gate 70 live (settingsError null), no halt, A+B bridges reporting, syntax clean, no secrets tracked. TOP ISSUE: journal .rr stores the SIGNAL's planned R:R next to the BROKER's realized prices (index.js:2590) — the single journal trade records rr 2.5 while its own prices imply 6.57 and it closed at exactly its stop (-1.0R); get_performance therefore reports avgRR +2.5 on a 0% win rate. This is the mechanism behind the known "rr-artifact" inflation. Also: 2 watchdogs alive (one orphaned, paired heartbeats since 02/08 15:51), saveLearning() swallows all write errors, startup_all.ps1 untagged-bridge warning is a permanent false positive, Brave+Exa API keys invalid.

SESSION 2026-08-03: THREE COMMITS 5b36001, 6c64458, 9d5301a. Every one is a silent-loss or silent-wrong-number bug; none changed signal generation. (1) 5b36001 tasks/daily/2026-08-02.json was INVALID JSON - a hand-appended entry missing its comma - and daily_notes._load_note swallowed JSONDecodeError and returned an EMPTY note. It feeds a read-modify-write (log_entry, auto_log), so the next `daily_notes.py log` would have saved that empty note over the file and erased the entire 08-02 session record. Backed up first, comma restored, both entries intact at 7542 bytes. Parse failure now exits loud and leaves the file byte-identical - verified on a deliberately corrupt fixture. Two more silent failures in the same file: auto_log tested isinstance(trades, list) but /api/journal answers {"journal":[...]}, and filtered on `opened_at` where the journal carries `openTime` - NO TRADE HAS EVER REACHED A DAILY NOTE. _save_note now writes temp+rename. (2) 6c64458 /api/trade-opened copied sig.rr - the SIGNAL's planned R:R - into the journal row beside entry/sl/tp taken from the BROKER's fill. The two described different trades: the only real trade stored rr 2.5 while its own prices imply 6.57, and it closed at exactly its stop for -1.00R. That is the mechanism behind the rr-artifact inflation - /api/stats/by-setup averaged the stored field and reported avgRR +2.5 on a 0% win rate. rr is now derived from the row's own prices, plannedRr preserves the signal's intent, and by-setup derives from prices so rows written earlier are corrected ON READ - journal history is read, never rewritten. Endpoint now returns avgRR 6.6 / avgRealizedR -1.00 for BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH. (3) 9d5301a saveLearning ended in `catch (e) {}` - a locked or unwritable learning.json discarded every recorded outcome with nothing in the log. Both saveJournal and saveLearning also wrote in place, so a crash mid-write truncates the one file CLAUDE.md marks irreplaceable. Both now temp+rename via writeJsonAtomic, traced against overwrite / create / unwritable-path. learning.json verified byte-identical across two restarts except sessionCount 78->79. SERVER RESTARTED TWICE by PID (never /T), bridges untouched and both reconnected; healer 7/7, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, settingsError null, halted false, all three assets WAIT conf 0 on dataSource mt5. TWO ACTIVE-PRIORITIES ITEMS ARE STALE AND SHOULD BE CLOSED: open item #1 'a candle push does not trigger a signal recompute' is FULLY FIXED on both halves - index.js:2120-2134 recomputes on the yahoo->mt5 transition (observed firing 35s after my restart) and mt5_bridge.py:985-990 refuses to execute a signal stamped dataSource:'yahoo' for a symbol it has pushed bars for. Item #3 'the MCP tools do not exist' is also stale - smartentry MCP is live in .mcp.json. PROCESS HYGIENE: found TWO watchdogs - PID 18912 whose parent was already gone, and PID 20700 supervised by the live guardian 11256. Stopped the unsupervised orphan only; one guardian-supervised watchdog remains. Confirmed exactly TWO bridges (A #25446287, B #11581419) from the tagged .bat launchers - no untagged third. STILL OPEN, NEEDS AN ELEVATED SHELL: SmartEntryPro still carries DisallowStartIfOnBatteries=True AND StopIfGoingOnBatteries=True and the laptop is ON BATTERY right now - Set-ScheduledTask returns Access Denied unelevated. 'SmartEntry Ensure Running' has its flags cleared and ran result=0 at 03:41, so recovery is covered, but SmartEntryPro itself is still refused. ALSO OPEN: 'SmartEntry - Daily Check' is named daily but carries a WEEKLY trigger (last 01/08); SmartEntryVPSBackupPull has not run since 01/08 04:00 so the off-box backup has not been pulled in two days. UNRESOLVED AND UNCHANGED: local Bridge B and VPS Bridge A both trade account 11581419 in --auto with separate 3-loss breakers - one signal opens two positions and the breaker needs six losses.

VPS DEPLOYED 2026-08-03 04:56 VPS time. c8c3d82 -> e093ea8 (6 commits), clean fast-forward, all 7 protected live-state files SHA-256 UNCHANGED (smartentry.db + shm + wal, learning.json, hermes_state.json, jarvis_memory.json, strategy_settings.json). Backup at C:ps-state-backup-20260803-045416. VERIFIED AFTER: healer healthy, Bridge A connected (1/1 expected reporting), 0 positions, halted false, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, settingsError null, all three assets WAIT conf 0 on dataSource mt5 with broker symbols. TWO TRAPS HIT AND SOLVED, BOTH WORTH REMEMBERING. (1) I CAUSED ONE: `git add -A` in the session-log commit newly tracked server/strategy_settings.json AND server/journal.json - neither was tracked at 4b5eb07. strategy_settings.json is per-machine EXACTLY so a shared commit cannot push one box's fixedLotSize onto the other, which is the failure that reset VPS sizing on 2026-08-02. Caught it by diffing the commit before deploying, not after. Fixed in e093ea8: both untracked via `git rm --cached` and added to .gitignore, working copies intact. Local strategy_settings verified still gate 70 / fixedLot 0.01. NEVER USE `git add -A` IN THIS REPO. (2) THE PULL ABORTS TWICE unless the order is right: git refuses on locally-modified tracked files (server/learning.json, tasks/jarvis_memory.json) AND on untracked files it would overwrite (tasks/daily/2026-08-01.json, 2026-08-02.json, both trivial auto-generated PLAN notes on the VPS). Correct order is: back up -> move untracked blockers aside to .vpslocal (never delete) -> `git checkout --` the conflicting tracked files -> pull -> restore live state from backup -> verify hashes. Restoring BEFORE the pull re-dirties the files and the pull aborts again - my first attempt did exactly that and HEAD silently stayed at c8c3d82 while the log said 'Updating c8c3d82..e093ea8'. ALWAYS CONFIRM HEAD MOVED; the Updating line prints even when the pull aborts. (3) The db is held open by the running server, so Get-FileHash fails - read it with [System.IO.File]::Open($p,'Open','Read','ReadWrite'). (4) VPS server restarts cleanly via Stop-ScheduledTask/Start-ScheduledTask SmartEntryServer; bridges are untouched by that. DIVERGENCE NOTED, NOT CHANGED: VPS maxTradesPerDay=10, local=5. Same gate (70) and same fixedLotSize (0.01), but the two boxes have different daily trade caps. Per-machine file, so this is legal - flagging it because it is invisible from git and neither note recorded it before.

CORRECTION to this session's earlier note: I was WRONG that SmartEntryVPSBackupPull had not run since 01/08 and that the off-box backup was two days stale. I read the task's LastRunTime at 03:47; it fired on schedule at 04:00 the SAME MORNING and pulled backup_20260803_030003.zip (1,745,475 bytes, 315 files) into vps-backups\. Archive verified: zipfile.testzip() clean, contains learning.json, smartentry.db, tasks/jarvis_memory.json, server/hermes_state.json and server/strategy_settings.json, and correctly EXCLUDES keys.env and apikey.txt. StartWhenAvailable was already True and the battery flags already clear - there was nothing to fix. LESSON: a scheduled task's LastRunTime is only evidence about the past, not about whether the task is broken; check the task's own output (here pull_log.txt and the destination directory) before calling it dead. The one REAL and minor behaviour: the pull only happens when this laptop is awake at 04:00 - pull_log.txt shows 26/07, 28/07 and 03/08 with nothing between. Nothing was lost, because the VPS keeps its own daily archives on-box (30/07 through 03/08 all present at C:i-trading-dashboard-backups). Only the local copies are intermittent.

ONE --AUTO BRIDGE PER ACCOUNT - SHIPPED AND LIVE ON BOTH BOXES (3580684, 4de01cd). MEASURED FIRST, AND THE BOARD OVERSTATED IT: both bridges read mt5.positions_get(), which is the BROKER's view of the shared account, not their own server's - so maxConcurrentPositions=3 and sizing.js:207's symbol+direction duplicate guard DID both work across the two boxes. The real exposure was a RACE: the window between reading positions and placing the order spans an Opus approval call with a 25s timeout, and the two bridges poll on unsynchronised 60s cycles, so roughly 1 signal in 6 could double-fill - not every one. What was genuinely unprotected: circuit breakers did NOT combine (3 consecutive losses each = six on that account before both halted), daily caps did NOT combine (local 5 + VPS 10 = up to 15/day), and the trade record was SPLIT across two journals so neither box held the full history of 11581419 - which directly undercuts the reason the current config is being run at all. FIX: local Bridge B stopped; the fleet is now local A=25446287, VPS A=11581419, one --auto bridge per account. tasks/ensure_running.ps1 and tasks/watchdog.bat now take their bridge list from MT5_EXPECTED_ACCOUNTS in keys.env (the same variable the healer reads), so what we start, what we restart and what we alarm about cannot disagree. Both fall back to A,B on a missing file, missing variable, empty value or parse error - never to an empty list, which would start no bridges at all. All five failure modes traced before anything was stopped. TWO BUGS CAUGHT IN MY OWN CODE BEFORE THEY WENT LIVE. (1) findstr WITHOUT /c: SPLITS THE PATTERN ON SPACES and searches each piece separately, so '[ ]*=' matched any line containing '=' - a keys.env holding FOO=bar set EXPECTED_TAGS to 'bar' and Bridge B would have been restarted anyway. Fixed with /c: and re-traced. (2) I filtered processes by CommandLine LIKE '*start_bridge_B.bat*' and my OWN PowerShell process matched, because the filter string appears in the script text - it stopped Bridge B correctly and then killed its own shell. Never match a process by a substring the matching script itself contains. THE BIG ONE - keys.env WAS PARSED BUT NEVER REACHED process.env, SO IT CONFIGURED NOTHING (4de01cd). readKeysEnv() has always read the file; nothing ever copied the result into process.env, so every process.env.X lookup in server/index.js used its default regardless of what keys.env said. Symptom that exposed it: keys.env carried MT5_EXPECTED_ACCOUNTS=A and the healer kept reporting '1/2 expected - B has never connected' on a machine that now deliberately owns one bridge. PLACEMENT IS THE WHOLE FIX: a loader lower in the file was STILL too late, because autohealer.js:33 captures EXPECTED_MT5_ACCOUNTS at MODULE-LOAD time, so anything after require('./autohealer') never sees it. The loader now runs above the local requires. Real env vars still win (only unset keys are filled), empty values are skipped, unreadable file logs and continues on defaults. Verified expected count 2 -> 1 across a restart with no other change. AUDITED BEFORE DEPLOYING THIS TO THE VPS: the VPS keys.env additionally holds TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, so the loader could have newly switched on Telegram polling there. Checked the VPS server log first - 3700 of the last 4000 lines are 'status code 409', i.e. it is ALREADY polling, so those keys are already in that process's environment and the loader is a no-op for them. Deployed only after confirming that. STATE NOW - LOCAL: HEAD 4de01cd, healer 1/1, Bridge A #25446287 connected, no Bridge B process or wrapper, watchdog's last B restart was 04:14:40 (before the new logic loaded at 04:15:50) and none since, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, halted false. VPS: HEAD 4de01cd, all 7 protected files SHA-256 UNCHANGED (backup C:ps-state-backup-20260803-052344), healer 1/1, Bridge A #11581419 connected, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, maxTradesPerDay 10, settingsError null. VPS signals read src=yahoo immediately after its restart - expected, and handled: the server recomputes on the yahoo->mt5 transition and the bridge refuses to trade a yahoo-stamped signal for a symbol it has pushed bars for. ALSO DONE: Brave API key stored as a Windows user env var via setx (never in a file, never committed) and validated live against api.search.brave.com - HTTP 200. Reaches the MCP server after a Claude Code restart. STILL OPEN: Telegram 409 loop is real and large (3700 errors) - one poller or two tokens; SmartEntryPro's two battery flags need an elevated shell; 'SmartEntry - Daily Check' carries a weekly trigger; Exa key still invalid; ensure_running.ps1 still launches BOTH MT5 terminals (deliberate - an idle terminal is harmless and narrowing the change reduced blast radius).

AI PIPELINE FIXED AND PROVEN - FIRST REAL ANALYSIS OUTPUT THIS SYSTEM HAS EVER PRODUCED (9739d2c, dd823f7). ROOT CAUSE, found by elimination after two wrong hypotheses of mine: cmd.exe TRUNCATED EVERY AGENT PROMPT AT THE FIRST NEWLINE. find_claude() resolves to claude.CMD; subprocess.run executes a .CMD through cmd.exe, which re-parses argv and treats a newline as a command separator. Proved with a 3-marker probe: the agent received LINE_ONE_MARKER and nothing else. The analyst briefs put OUTPUT_FILE and the FACTS path after blank lines, so every analyst got only line one of its brief - knew the topic, never learned where the data was or where to write, replied 'I don't have the data, could you paste it?', which the harness logged as 'no JSON object in response'. Same for the synthesiser and for /engineer --plan, which only ever received 'You are a senior engineer and architect.' FIX: prompts go in on stdin, which cmd.exe cannot re-parse. WRONG HYPOTHESES I RULED OUT ON THE WAY (all measured, not guessed): add_dirs/--add-dir (landed 4b5eb07, real but incidental - probe read an 883KB file fine); prompt size (only ~2200 chars); the appended system prompt (probe passed with it); 5-way concurrency (5 parallel probes all returned DONE). What isolated it was that identical invocations from git bash worked while the module's failed - bash resolves 'claude' to a shim that does not go through cmd.exe. RESULT: all 5 analysts wrote real reports (9-13KB each) plus a 42KB synthesis; reports file 55,969 bytes vs 5,753 bytes of pure _error before; pipeline exit 0 vs exit 2. WHAT THE ANALYSIS ACTUALLY SAYS over 2381 replayed trades 2021-09..2026-07: the system is NOT broken, it is UN-GATED and has no edge net of its own cost assumption - overall expectancyR 0.036 against costAssumptionR 0.05. ONE condition accounts for the entire deficit and more: entry RSI below 50 covers 459 closed trades worth -78.4R, while the remaining 1796 make +159.9R at PF 1.22, expectancyR 0.089 - and it improves ALL FOUR time quartiles (0.010->0.064, 0.017->0.041, 0.080->0.166, 0.038->0.085), so it is not a window artefact. The synthesiser found what none of the five analysts did: the per-setup regime gates three of them ranked #1 are STRICT SUBSETS of the RSI rule (all 90 RANGE_TRADE_LONG, all 130 BUY_OVERSOLD, all 227 STRONG DOWNTREND trades sit inside RSI<50), so they are redundant, not additive; and SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT, scored healthy at +24.18R, is TWO populations - +58.5R PF 1.65 above RSI 50 and -34.3R PF 0.87 below it. Only genuinely independent leak: SPX on H4, still -47.6R after the RSI gate, negative in all four quartiles, driven by SPX|MOMENTUM|H4 -39.2R over 378 trades while the SAME setup earns +101.1R on Gold and +42.9R on BTC. It also flags that the one auto-tunable lever (adxTrendingMin) can now only do harm: after the RSI gate the sub-threshold bucket is PROFITABLE (adx<20: 682 trades, PF 1.10, +11.4R). NOTHING IMPLEMENTED - all of this is signal generation and needs Themis's explicit approval per CLAUDE.md. LAPTOP AUTOMATION FIXED TOO: auto_daily.bat, morning_agent.bat and auto_weekly.bat all ran claude from INSIDE the project, so it booted as JARVIS and obeyed 'one question at a time - then stop'. Proof from the logs: the morning agent's entire output on 25/07 was 'Want me to build those two endpoints now?' and morning_summary.txt was never written; the only weekly report ever produced is 75 bytes containing nothing but the two header lines the script echoed. All three now run from a clean room with --add-dir and a non-interactive system prompt. Also fixed in them: gate hardcoded 65 vs live 70 (now read from /api/strategy-settings); msg.exe was the last command so it set the exit code, which is the FAILED(1) on the weekly task, not the analysis; morning_agent told an unattended agent to EDIT server/index.js AND COMMIT every morning - now it writes a proposal instead; a bare '65%' was itself a .bat escaping bug. VERIFIED LIVE: auto_daily.bat exit 0 with a full real report reading the live gate 70. CORRECTIONS TO MY OWN EARLIER CLAIMS THIS SESSION: SmartEntryPro is NOT blocked (ran 04:48 today, result 0); Daily Check and Morning Agent are NOT broken (their REFUSED codes were stale from 01/08, flags already clear, both scheduled to run today). Daily Check DID have a real fault - a WEEKLY trigger despite its name - now changed to daily, next run 07:30.
